title: The Room That Could Hear a Rocket
synopsis: The children tour mission control, meet adult pilot Max, and see Star Harbor ready for incoming rocket parts.
continuity_state: Before: Ground infrastructure has been built and checked; no assembled crew rocket stands at the pad. Dr. Ada has shown the mission drawing. After: Mission control, antenna systems, tower and heavy vehicle route are ready for integration. Max is the pilot; Dr. Ada remains on Earth. No rocket has launched yet.
